verdict.rationale: LocalAI ships a built-in AI agent platform, configurable from its web interface and backed by MCP tool support. It also ships `local-ai chat`, a shell agent that answers questions, reads files and runs commands behind a user-controlled approval gate, so users can delegate tasks without extra tools. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agent task delegation, and deeper documentation of the web-UI agent workflow (task setup, monitoring, results).
